caption: The drawing features a simple, outlined vase with a narrow base widening towards the shoulders and tapering at the neck, decorated with a horizontal band of blue circles and lines. From the vase emerges a bouquet of various flowers and leaves. The flowers include several types and colors: a prominent large pink flower to the right, a purple flower near the top center, a red flower on the left, smaller yellow flowers, some white flowers, and other small blossoms in pink and blue. There are multiple green leafy stems and foliage, including slender fern-like leaves, broad green leaves, and brown leaves. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the entire composition is enclosed within a double-ruled rectangular border. The color palette includes pink, red, yellow, blue, purple, green, brown, and beige.
title: Embroidered Picture
